predictive_law: unchanged old-only selected air32 CSDI, 32 conditional draws
learning_scope: F2 score-head refitting; probability reconstruction remains frozen as in the new-data specification
old_source_roles: existing disjoint Swiss development/calibration/test; no new Australian temperature or errors used
threshold_family: 21 quantiles of refitted training scores, unique finite candidates; never calibration/test selected
risk_estimand: E[group failure-and-admission]/E[group admission], equal original group weight
gain_rule: both paired Hoeffding lower bounds in [-1,1] exceed 0.05
simulation_population: independent draws from separate finite empirical old-group laws; repeated support does not create new observed groups or process types
reference_policy: all three methods must satisfy evaluation risk evidence with positive admission; candidate must beat each direct reference
sample_size_recommendation: none for a new target population from old-only simulated power; any supported old-like budget still requires independent recruitment and target-population assumptions
